_readme: OVERRIDES ONLY. This file is normally empty of companies, and that is
correct: the website fallback discovers a company's site from BSE's own
company information and works out how to read it, so no entry is needed
for the ordinary case. Measured on 2026-09-03, discovery produced
documents for 7 of 8 sampled companies with no configuration at all.
Add an entry only when discovery fails or gets it wrong: BSE lists no
website or a stale one, the documents live on a page the crawl does not
reach, or a strategy needs pinning. An entry always wins over discovery.
Keyed by BSE scrip code as a string:
company   label used in output, purely cosmetic
base_url  site root; every path below is resolved against it
strategy  auto (default), html_links, or js_bundle
pages     html_links only: the pages to read (default: base_url alone)
bundles   js_bundle only: pin the script paths instead of discovering them
notes     why this entry exists, for whoever has to fix it later
What an entry cannot fix: a site behind a bot-protection challenge.
Astra Microwave (scrip 540017, astramwp.com) answers every request with
HTTP 307 and no Location header, which needs a browser engine rather than
a different URL. Such a site is reported and the run continues on BSE.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
Example entry, kept here rather than active because discovery already
handles this company correctly:
"company": "Avantel Ltd",
"base_url": "https://www.avantel.in/",
"strategy": "js_bundle",
"notes": "React app; documents are {name, pdf} pairs in the hashed bundle."
